description: Source code for a Zephyr driver emulator for the AMD SB TSI sensor, including register handling, I2C transfer simulation, and sensor channel emulation.

methods.name: sb_tsi_emul_set_reg
methods.description: Sets the value of a register in the emulator.

methods.name: sb_tsi_emul_get_reg
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a register from the emulator.

methods.name: sb_tsi_emul_reset
methods.description: Resets all emulator registers to zero.

methods.name: sb_tsi_emul_transfer_i2c
methods.description: Handles I2C transfer simulation for the emulator.

methods.name: sb_tsi_emul_set_channel
methods.description: Sets the sensor channel value in the emulator.

methods.name: sb_tsi_emul_get_sample_range
methods.description: Provides the sample range for the sensor channel.
